description: Shared definitions for the selfcommand admin service. All methods in this namespace require a service JWT obtained from the caller's PDS (com.atproto.server.getServiceAuth) with aud set to the admin service DID and lxm set to the invoked method.

roleName.description: Role assigned to an administrator account. admin manages settings, roles, approvals and account administration; moderator handles reports, content and verification actions; operator holds read access to the directory, content and reports; viewer is read-only over the directory, content, reports, verification and analytics.

permission.description: Server-side permission granted to a role. UI visibility is never a substitute for these checks.

subject.description: DID of the account holding the role.

grantedBy.description: DID of the administrator that created or last changed the binding.

actor.description: DID of the authenticated caller; anonymous failures are only logged and never stored.

action.description: XRPC method or semantic action name.

detail.description: Redacted supplementary information; never contains tokens, passwords, email addresses or full request bodies.

requestId.description: Request identifier returned to the caller in the x-request-id response header.

actorIp.description: Source address of the request, truncated to a safe length.

userAgent.description: Client identifier supplied by the caller, truncated to a safe length.

before.description: Structured value before a change; only present on mutation events.

after.description: Structured value after a change; only present on mutation events.

lastEventAt.description: Time of the last identity or account event applied to this entry.

cursor.description: Opaque firehose cursor persisted by the indexer.

settingSection.description: Runtime setting partition. Every partition is versioned and audited independently.

accountOperations.description: Shows account note, tag, sync and export entry points. Visibility only; permissions still apply.

approvals.description: Shows the approval center entry point. High-risk actions still require an approval server-side.

securityCenter.description: Shows the access activity and block entry points. Visibility only; security.read still applies.

dashboardTrends.description: Shows daily metric trends on the dashboard.

settingsPatch.description: Partial settings document used by import. Omitted partitions keep their current values; every supplied partition is validated before any write.

filterMacro.description: Saved filter preset for the moderation reports or events list, kept per administrator account.

isDefault.description: When true the macro is applied automatically when the list page opens. At most one default macro per scope.

filterMacroFilters.description: Filter values captured by a saved macro. Only fields relevant to the macro scope are applied.

note.description: Operational note kept in the admin console only. It never changes the account on the community.

syncPaused.description: When true the directory indexer stops applying events for this account; the community account is unaffected.

approvalAction.description: High-risk action that requires approval from a second administrator. Moderation, verification and account actions are executed against the upstream service on approval.

day.description: Calendar day in the report timezone, formatted YYYY-MM-DD.

moderationSubjectType.description: Kind of subject handled by moderation: an account, a record, a chat message or a conversation.

reportAction.description: Action applied to a single report.

moderationAction.description: Moderation event emitted against one or more subjects.

subject.description: Account DID or record AT-URI that was reported.

hidden.description: True when the subject is taken down or restricted upstream.

reviewState.description: Review state of a moderated subject: needs review, closed, escalated to a higher queue, or no review yet.

announcementLevel.description: Visual severity of an announcement: informational, warning or critical.

announcementPlacement.description: Where the announcement is shown: the admin console or the public application.

publicAnnouncementView.description: Whitelisted public fields of a published announcement; no internal identifiers or operator identities.
